item.text: {"issues":[{"description":"Users report being unable to sign in because their account credentials are not accepted.","issue_id":"I_ACCESS","issue_name":"Account sign-in failures"},{"description":"Users object to basic playback controls and listening features being restricted to Premium subscribers.","issue_id":"I_BILLING","issue_name":"Premium restrictions on basic features"},{"description":"Users report missing songs or lyrics and dissatisfaction with music recommendations.","issue_id":"I_CATALOG","issue_name":"Catalog, lyrics, and recommendations"},{"description":"Users report that offline listening does not work and may consider canceling Premium as a result.","issue_id":"I_DOWNLOADS","issue_name":"Offline listening failures"},{"description":"Users express general dissatisfaction with the app and intentions to uninstall without identifying a specific product issue.","issue_id":"I_OTHER","issue_name":"General app dissatisfaction"},{"description":"Users report launch, loading, connectivity, playback interruption, and audio-control failures.","issue_id":"I_PLAYBACK","issue_name":"Playback and app reliability"},{"description":"Users report excessive advertisements, unwanted random playback, and removal of basic player features.","issue_id":"I_USABILITY","issue_name":"Ads and playback controls"}]}
